templates.title: Homarr v2
templates.name: homarr-v2
templates.description: Homarr v2 dashboard. This is a new app, separate from Homarr v1. The default SQLite database moves by copying /appdata and keeping the same SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY. An external PostgreSQL database is not in /appdata. Stop v1, back up that database, then set the same DB_DIALECT and DB_URL and leave v1 stopped while v2 migrates it. MySQL is no longer supported; convert existing MySQL data to SQLite before starting v2. Not compatible with legacy Homarr (v0.x) data without migration.

env.name: SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.label: SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.description: 64 character hex string. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep the v1 key if you copy its appdata.

env.name: DB_DIALECT
env.label: DB_DIALECT
env.description: Database dialect. Leave sqlite unless v1 used an external PostgreSQL database, in which case set postgresql.

env.name: DB_URL
env.label: DB_URL
env.description: Database URL. Leave the SQLite default, or set the same PostgreSQL URL used by Homarr v1. Stop v1 and back up that database before starting v2 against it. Copying /appdata does not copy an external database.
